verdict.rationale: Documenting the lawful handling of biometric data is a fair ask of an identity-verification vendor, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on GDPR lawful bases, BIPA or other US biometric statutes, or consent language. The items cover only verification flows, screening, monitoring and team access.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor documents how biometric data is handled lawfully — GDPR bases, US biometric statutes like BIPA, and the consent language my flow needs — so legal review has something to review
